title: Woman TV Screen Broadcast Portrait, 1970s B&W Photograph
description: A dark black-and-white photograph taken directly off a CRT television screen, showing a close-up portrait of a woman with short dark styled hair and hoop earrings, wearing a turtleneck and blazer. The prominent scan lines across the image highlight the analog broadcast medium of the era. Photographing television screens was a popular method for preserving live broadcasts prior to the widespread availability of home VCR recording technology in the late 1970s.
